data.reasoning: The package is a standard binary AUR package downloading pinned artifacts from its own upstream GitHub releases. The only model that successfully completed the audit correctly identified the lack of top-level execution, pinned checksums, and standard installation paths. The other models returned inconclusive solely due to API and parse errors, not security concerns.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was triggered by tool failures (API 404s and parse errors) in two of the models, resulting in 'inconclusive' verdicts, while the third model successfully audited the files and returned 'safe'. There is no actual security disagreement.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed with HTTP 404 API errors for both files
openrouter model failed to parse the decision for .SRCINFO
learnings: The escalation trigger should filter out 'inconclusive' verdicts caused by tool or API errors when a valid, successful audit report exists.
Distinguish between semantic inconclusiveness (ambiguous code) and technical inconclusiveness (model crashes or parse failures) when calculating agreement.
